Resource Type:
BGM & SE
Maker Format:
RM2K3
Makers I Own:
RM2K,RM2K3,XP,VX,Ace,MV, MZ
Description:
I was having trouble converting OGG and MIDI files into a format that RM2K3 recognizes.  Basically, trying to convert all BGM & SE from other maker engines into RM2K3.  Can anyone help me out?

posts.author: EntangledPear
posts.body: I don't use the older versions, can you share what audio formats they use? Or is the problem that you don't know what format you need to convert into? I think we might need more details.

posts.author: xclnth
posts.body:
Audio
MIDI (.mid): RPG Maker 2003 supports MIDI Standard Format 1 for background music.
WAV (.wav): WAV is a common Windows audio format supported by RM2K3, specifically PCM and ADPCM codecs.
MP3 (.mp3): MP3 support was added in a later update (version 1.05 or later)
So MP3 would probably be best.

posts.author: EntangledPear
posts.body: So you basically need to convert OGG into MP3, right? I would recommend using Audacity for that (you can find it and download it online for free). Then you just open the music file (OGG) in it and choose export as MP3 and you're done (it can also export the other formats you mention).

posts.author: xclnth
posts.body: Thank you. I will try this
